description: This file defines the class 'FieldConfigDeleteForm' which provides a form for deleting a field configuration from a bundle in Drupal's field UI module. It includes methods for building the form, handling deletion logic, and redirecting after deletion.

classes.name: Drupal ield_ui orm ieldConfigDeleteForm
classes.description: A form class for deleting field configurations from bundles in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting EntityTypeBundleInfoInterface and EntityTypeManagerInterface dependencies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, removing dependencies related to the field being deleted.

methods.name: getConfigNamesToDelete
methods.description: Returns configuration names to delete, including dependencies if only one bundle remains.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect to if the deletion is canceled.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles the form submission, deletes the field if unlocked, and redirects.
